title: StandingOrder
description: A signed, narrow, time-bounded pre-commitment from one supervisor for one site.

standing_order_id.description: UUID4 minted at creation; never reused.

site_id.description: One site only. A multi-site order is unrepresentable.

supervisor_id.description: The supervisor who must sign this order.

match.description: How strictly the invoked stage must match.

type.description: Always official_stage_invocation. No other trigger type exists.

trigger.description: A single trigger. A multi-trigger order is unrepresentable.

action.description: Closed action vocabulary. Exactly the two from the product example.

parameters.description: Explicit parameters for the action; no arbitrary code or instruction.

actions.description: Non-empty list of explicit actions. A standing order must pre-commit to at least one.

valid_from.description: ISO-8601 instant the order becomes eligible to fire.

valid_until.description: Hard expiry. A time-bounded pre-commitment does not outlive its window.

status.description: Lifecycle status. Authoritative status at any instant is projected, not read.

signed_at.description: When the named supervisor signed. None until confirmed.

commitment_hash.description: SHA-256 over the signed fields. Only meaningful after signing.

trigger_fingerprint.description: Fingerprint of the trigger that fired this order, if any.

triggered_at.description: When the machine was started, if ever.

completed_at.description: When the machine reached Audit, if ever.

expired_at.description: When the order passed valid_until, if ever.
